edits.old: Then an action that does not exist or is outside the scope is answered 404 and nothing is written
edits.new:
Then an action that does not exist or is outside the scope is answered 404 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write has been accepted under an idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the replay returns the result of the first write
    Then nothing is written a second time

edits.old: Then nothing is written a second time
edits.new:
Then nothing is written a second time

  Scenario: AC12 An activity is retried or times out
    Given an activity of LitigationWorkflow is retried or does not finish in time
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then the decision record is written once and the case move is answered once
    Then a timed-out activity leaves nothing written and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope
